mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM orders WHERE paid_at >= #{todayFrom} AND paid_at < #{todayTo}), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(deposit_amount) FROM bookings WHERE deposit_paid_at >= #{todayFrom} AND deposit_paid_at < #{todayTo}), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(balance_amount) FROM bookings WHERE balance_paid_at >= #{todayFrom} AND balance_paid_at < #{todayTo}), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(total_price) FROM pass_purchases WHERE purchased_at >= #{todayFrom} AND purchased_at < #{todayTo}), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(customer_refund_amount) FROM refunds WHERE status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND succeeded_at >= #{todayFrom} AND succeeded_at < #{todayTo} AND payment_attempt_id IS NULL), 0) AS todayRevenue, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE paid_at >= #{todayFrom} AND paid_at < #{todayTo}) AS todayOrderCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'PAID_APPROVAL_PENDING') AS pendingApprovalCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookings WHERE status = 'BOOKED' AND created_at >= #{todayCreatedFrom} AND created_at < #{todayCreatedTo}) AS todayBookingCount, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM orders WHERE paid_at >= #{rangeFrom} AND paid_at < #{rangeTo}), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(deposit_amount) FROM bookings WHERE deposit_paid_at >= #{rangeFrom} AND deposit_paid_at < #{rangeTo}), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(balance_amount) FROM bookings WHERE balance_paid_at >= #{rangeFrom} AND balance_paid_at < #{rangeTo}), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(total_price) FROM pass_purchases WHERE purchased_at >= #{rangeFrom} AND purchased_at < #{rangeTo}), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(customer_refund_amount) FROM refunds WHERE status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND succeeded_at >= #{rangeFrom} AND succeeded_at < #{rangeTo} AND payment_attempt_id IS NULL), 0) AS monthRevenue, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE paid_at >= #{rangeFrom} AND paid_at < #{rangeTo}) AS monthOrderCount

SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(flow.occurredAt, '%Y-%m-%d')
DATE_FORMAT(flow.occurredAt, '%x-W%v')
DATE_FORMAT(flow.occurredAt, '%Y-%m')
AS periodLabel, COALESCE(SUM(flow.amount), 0) AS totalRevenue, SUM(flow.orderCount) AS orderCount, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(flow.amount) / NULLIF(SUM(flow.orderCount), 0)), 0) AS avgOrderValue FROM ( SELECT paid_at AS occurredAt, total_amount AS amount, 1 AS orderCount FROM orders WHERE paid_at >= #{rangeFrom} AND paid_at < #{rangeTo} UNION ALL SELECT succeeded_at AS occurredAt, -customer_refund_amount AS amount, 0 AS orderCount FROM refunds WHERE status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND order_id IS NOT NULL AND succeeded_at >= #{rangeFrom} AND succeeded_at < #{rangeTo} ) flow GROUP BY periodLabel ORDER BY periodLabel

SELECT net.orderRevenue, net.bookingDepositRevenue, net.bookingBalanceRevenue, net.passPurchaseRevenue, net.orderRevenue + net.bookingDepositRevenue + net.bookingBalanceRevenue + net.passPurchaseRevenue AS totalRevenue FROM ( SELECT COALESCE((SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM orders WHERE paid_at >= #{rangeFrom} AND paid_at < #{rangeTo}), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(customer_refund_amount) FROM refunds WHERE status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND order_id IS NOT NULL AND succeeded_at >= #{rangeFrom} AND succeeded_at < #{rangeTo}), 0) AS orderRevenue, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(deposit_amount) FROM bookings WHERE deposit_paid_at >= #{rangeFrom} AND deposit_paid_at < #{rangeTo}), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(customer_refund_amount) FROM refunds WHERE status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND booking_id IS NOT NULL AND succeeded_at >= #{rangeFrom} AND succeeded_at < #{rangeTo}), 0) AS bookingDepositRevenue, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(balance_amount) FROM bookings WHERE balance_paid_at >= #{rangeFrom} AND balance_paid_at < #{rangeTo}), 0) AS bookingBalanceRevenue, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(total_price) FROM pass_purchases WHERE purchased_at >= #{rangeFrom} AND purchased_at < #{rangeTo}), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(customer_refund_amount) FROM refunds WHERE status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND pass_purchase_id IS NOT NULL AND succeeded_at >= #{rangeFrom} AND succeeded_at < #{rangeTo}), 0) AS passPurchaseRevenue ) net
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT refunded.cnt AS totalRefundCount, refunded.amount AS totalRefundedAmount, COALESCE(ROUND(refunded.amount / NULLIF(gross.amount, 0), 4), 0) AS refundRate FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, COALESCE(SUM(customer_refund_amount), 0) AS amount FROM refunds WHERE status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND succeeded_at >= #{rangeFrom} AND succeeded_at < #{rangeTo} AND payment_attempt_id IS NULL ) refunded, ( SELECT COALESCE((SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM orders WHERE paid_at >= #{rangeFrom} AND paid_at < #{rangeTo}), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(deposit_amount) FROM bookings WHERE deposit_paid_at >= #{rangeFrom} AND deposit_paid_at < #{rangeTo}), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(balance_amount) FROM bookings WHERE balance_paid_at >= #{rangeFrom} AND balance_paid_at < #{rangeTo}), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(total_price) FROM pass_purchases WHERE purchased_at >= #{rangeFrom} AND purchased_at < #{rangeTo}), 0) AS amount ) gross

SELECT DATE(flow.occurredAt) AS date, SUM(flow.amount) AS revenue FROM ( SELECT paid_at AS occurredAt, total_amount AS amount FROM orders WHERE paid_at >= #{rangeFrom} AND paid_at < #{rangeTo} UNION ALL SELECT deposit_paid_at AS occurredAt, deposit_amount AS amount FROM bookings WHERE deposit_paid_at >= #{rangeFrom} AND deposit_paid_at < #{rangeTo} UNION ALL SELECT balance_paid_at AS occurredAt, balance_amount AS amount FROM bookings WHERE balance_paid_at >= #{rangeFrom} AND balance_paid_at < #{rangeTo} UNION ALL SELECT purchased_at AS occurredAt, total_price AS amount FROM pass_purchases WHERE purchased_at >= #{rangeFrom} AND purchased_at < #{rangeTo} UNION ALL SELECT succeeded_at AS occurredAt, -customer_refund_amount AS amount FROM refunds WHERE status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND succeeded_at >= #{rangeFrom} AND succeeded_at < #{rangeTo} AND payment_attempt_id IS NULL ) flow GROUP BY date ORDER BY date
